context: Use the canonical todo-db init-project/wrapper contract or an equivalent thin wrapper backed by a project-local uv lock. Remove absolute and sibling paths. Do not copy tracker source into either consumer.
description: After BenchBox's package-only runtime is certified, migrate other consumers that currently depend on a sibling todo-db checkout or an absolute developer path. Apply the same locked-package contract to Oxbow and textcharts only after repository ownership, database identity, and clean-clone expectations are confirmed. This is a follow-up, not a prerequisite for the BenchBox cutover.

anti_patterns.dont: Assume the non-git Oxbow/textcharts directories are safe to mutate
anti_patterns.instead: Inventory and request owner authorization before implementation
anti_patterns.why: Their ownership and recovery boundaries require explicit confirmation

anti_patterns.dont: Use /Users/joe/Developer/todo-db or ../todo-db as the release contract
anti_patterns.instead: Use a project-local locked package environment
anti_patterns.why: That is not portable to a fresh clone or cloud runner

preserves.behavior: Each consumer retains a distinct project-bound database
No secondary consumer receives a copied tracker implementation
No token or hosted DSN credential is committed
Work stops if repository ownership or writable scope is ambiguous

verifications.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && gh repo clone joeharris76/Oxbow "$tmp/Oxbow" -- --quiet && gh repo clone joeharris76/textcharts "$tmp/textcharts" -- --quiet && for repo in "$tmp/Oxbow" "$tmp/textcharts"; do ! rg -n '/Users/joe/Developer/todo-db|\.\./todo-db' "$repo/_project/scripts" "$repo/skill-sync.yaml"; done
verifications.description: Fresh Oxbow and textcharts clones contain no absolute or sibling todo-db runtime path

verifications.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && gh repo clone joeharris76/Oxbow "$tmp/Oxbow" -- --quiet && gh repo clone joeharris76/textcharts "$tmp/textcharts" -- --quiet && for repo in "$tmp/Oxbow" "$tmp/textcharts"; do uv sync --project "$repo/_project/scripts" --locked && uv run --project "$repo/_project/scripts" --locked -- todo-db --version | grep -Fx 'todo-db 0.3.2' && test "$(shasum -a 256 "$repo/_project/scripts/vendor/todo_db-0.3.2-py3-none-any.whl" | awk '{print $1}')" = ddc8c56a8b9f11c550d8f3b81df568c6d111cc79c076cbc4bf7c03fd68a95fa4; done
verifications.description: Both fresh clones resolve todo-db 0.3.2 from the locked verified wheel

verifications.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && gh repo clone joeharris76/Oxbow "$tmp/Oxbow" -- --quiet && gh repo clone joeharris76/textcharts "$tmp/textcharts" -- --quiet && for repo in "$tmp/Oxbow" "$tmp/textcharts"; do uv run --project "$repo/_project/scripts" --locked -- python "$repo/_project/scripts/verify_todo_runtime.py"; done

work_units.evidence: Live GitHub inventory confirmed joeharris76/Oxbow and joeharris76/textcharts are unarchived main-branch repositories with ADMIN permission. Fresh clones at fcaa70279c5c8d004ff6227bc7fc8c11f276205a and b44f95cb37143e2ed902b68b9382c91407b27aab were used; the non-Git prototype directories were not mutation targets. Oxbow's root environment has unrelated local BenchBox/letterops sources, while textcharts' root is its distributable library environment, so isolated _project/scripts locks are the narrowest design. Scratch copies of the prototype databases migrated from schema 3 to 5 with identities oxbow/textcharts, preserving 24 items/32 events and 26 items/60 events respectively; original SHA-256 values remained a21c91f70fc3b156d605001f19ef57b4986d2fea181ded497d7ebdff744ae5fa and 43762a188b27a82e347f44d0c1df586e8fa92fb2f7b065f8e387d4b02552dcaf.
work_units.summary: Inventory Oxbow and textcharts ownership, manifests, target databases, and current wrapper paths

work_units.evidence: Oxbow commit cd2bda83ba8084fe1221dce7ed8bc5b47e6deccc and textcharts commit 717f66d6ee5dccf8a5f58b382745c4a124ec8cd5 add isolated _project/scripts uv locks, the verified vendored todo-db 0.3.2 wheel (SHA-256 ddc8c56a8b9f11c550d8f3b81df568c6d111cc79c076cbc4bf7c03fd68a95fa4), thin fixed-identity wrappers, scratch verification, .todo-db ignore rules, and skill-sync CLI pointers. Qualified PRs: https://github.com/joeharris76/Oxbow/pull/7 and https://github.com/joeharris76/textcharts/pull/7. Root package environments and legacy YAML/Markdown rollback sources were not modified.
work_units.summary: Pin the released todo-db package and replace non-portable runtime resolution

work_units.evidence: Exact fresh-clone verification rungs 3-5 passed after merged portability-proof follow-ups. Oxbow merged PRs https://github.com/joeharris76/Oxbow/pull/7 and https://github.com/joeharris76/Oxbow/pull/8; textcharts merged PRs https://github.com/joeharris76/textcharts/pull/7 and https://github.com/joeharris76/textcharts/pull/8. Both fresh main clones contain no absolute or sibling todo-db path, resolve todo-db 0.3.2 from the wheel with SHA-256 ddc8c56a8b9f11c550d8f3b81df568c6d111cc79c076cbc4bf7c03fd68a95fa4, and pass identity, v3-to-v5 migration, YAML mapping, non-holder release, audit, exact export/restore, credential-isolation, and nested-directory proofs. Hosted databases were not provisioned or mutated. textcharts' unrelated library coverage gate was already red at the pre-change main b44f95cb37143e2ed902b68b9382c91407b27aab (83.72% vs 85%) and remains a separate pre-existing gate.
work_units.summary: Run clean-clone wrapper, identity, lease-safety, and local/hosted backend checks
